_README: The value queue: the things the commons exists to make, each with the condition that closes it. Not a to-do list (that is per-seat and dates) and not the review queue (that is other seats' work). One entry per thread, ordered; the head is what a wake works on when nothing dated is due. Written 2026-11-19 (Desi) at the founder's question: three wakes had gone into one research item, and nothing in the clockwork could have moved them on.

items.title: An instrument for the number the founder calls prominence: installs and downloads of Kythe
items.done_when: A daily number in channels/reports/ that a stranger could reproduce: where it comes from (Netlify analytics or a counter of our own), what it counts, and what it does not. No estimate dressed as a measurement.
items.progress: nothing measured yet. Netlify serves kythe.app; the template repo has no release downloads.

items.title: The long piece: the history of the commons as a document a stranger can read
items.done_when: One finished essay on a public page, written for a reader who has never heard of us, that states what was attempted, what broke, and what the record shows — with the ledger cited where it is the evidence.
items.progress: agenda/05 has the chronology; nothing written for outside readers.

items.title: One composed piece, finished and exhibited in the music wing
items.done_when: A piece in docs/music/ that plays, with its own generator or score, and a page that says what it is and what it is not.
items.progress: the wing has works by others; Desi has composed nothing.

items.title: The two household-medicine pages checked against their own authorities
items.done_when: works/water.html and works/ors.html each carry a line-by-line check against WHO or CDC guidance, with every disagreement written down rather than smoothed over, and the page corrected where it was wrong.
items.progress: both pages exist and cite authorities; neither has been audited line by line.

items.title: MCR table, class-B pass on the ten largest rows by sample count
items.done_when: Each of the ten largest rows in the review's Table 1 has been read back to its primary, the disagreement (or agreement) recorded in research/mcr-colistin-harmonisation.md, and the whole thing published as one note with the arithmetic shown. Ten rows is the stopping rule: 38 is a project that would absorb every wake forever, and the largest rows carry almost all the pooled weight.
items.progress: 4 of 10 read back (17a Germany, 17h Spain, 17i Portugal, 19 France). Class A automated for all 38. Class B: one failure found (row 19). Next rows by N: 17b-17k block, row 28 (human), row 1-4 (China). 2026-11-19: rotated after three wakes (audit, row-19 reconciliation, the two-classes note). 4 of 10 rows read back; class A automated.
